page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: How Yggdrasil should behave on this computer.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose light, dark, or follow the system.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of menus, buttons, and messages in Yggdrasil on every computer and phone you use with it. Each device can follow its own system language.
language.saveFailed: The language could not be saved: {{error}}

personalization.title: Personalization
personalization.description: How answers should look, in every chat and automation. This shapes style only. What the AI may do is set under Tool permissions, and nothing here or in Memory can change it.
personalization.aboutYouPlaceholder: I'm a backend engineer in Juneau. My main project is a Go service.
personalization.instructions: Anything else about how to answer
personalization.instructionsPlaceholder: Show code examples in Go. Mention sources at the end.

background.title: Keep running in background
background.description: Closing the window keeps Chat, the API, and your schedules running. This stays on while a schedule exists.

launchAtLogin.title: Launch at login
launchAtLogin.description: Start Yggdrasil automatically when you sign in to this computer.

defaultProfile.title: Default profile
defaultProfile.description: Used when you start a new chat.

runOn.title: Run chats on
runOn.description: Where work should run by default across your team.

lifecycle.title: Model lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Automatic keeps models warm after chat. Manual leaves Start and Stop to you.
lifecycle.idleUnloadHint: Frees memory when a model hasn’t been used for a while. Use 0 to keep models loaded.

downloads.title: Download models
downloads.description: When a profile needs a model that isn’t installed yet.

advanced.title: Advanced mode
advanced.description: Show model IDs, API details, Profiles, logs, and other power-user controls.

discovery.title: Find other computers
discovery.description: Advertise this computer and look for other Yggdrasil installs on your network.
discovery.needsRestart: Networking was updated. Restart Yggdrasil so other computers can fully reach this one.
discovery.restartManually: Quit Yggdrasil completely, then open it again to finish applying network settings.

api.title: API access
api.description: How apps and other devices can talk to Yggdrasil.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Alerts for long-running work and team connectivity.
notifications.peerOffline: Notify when a paired computer goes offline

toolPermissions.title: Tool permissions
toolPermissions.description: Default rules for what the AI may do on this computer.

history.title: History
history.description: Control what Yggdrasil keeps on this computer.
history.confirmClear: Delete all chat history on this computer? This cannot be undone.

whatLeft.title: What left this computer
whatLeft.description: Yggdrasil works on this computer. These are the times a chat, automation, or app sent something elsewhere: web searches and pages, map lookups, paired computers, and connected services. Mark memories or knowledge “This computer only” to keep chats that use them here.
whatLeft.nothing: Nothing left this computer in the last 30 days.
whatLeft.confirmDelete: Delete run records now? This removes stored prompts and tool results from past runs, and this list. Chats are not deleted.
whatLeft.deleted: Deleted {{tasks}} run records, {{automations}} automation results, and {{entries}} entries below.
whatLeft.footnote: Run records hold prompts and tool results from past runs. Chats are kept or not by History below. Each automation keeps its latest result, which “notify when the result changes” compares against.

storage.pending: Will appear when Yggdrasil is running
storage.limitDescription: Soft limit for downloaded models on this computer.

reset.title: Reset application
reset.description: Restore defaults and restart onboarding. Clears chats, custom profiles, tasks, and API keys.
reset.warningKeep: This cannot be undone. You will go through onboarding again. Downloaded models and runtimes will be kept.
reset.warningDelete: This cannot be undone. You will go through onboarding again. Downloaded models will also be deleted.
reset.failed: Could not reset the application. Try again.
